This '''species''' was a [[Sentience|sentient]] [[species]] that existed in [[the galaxy]].<ref name="Mando 3" />

==Biology and appearance==
This [[humanoid]] [[Sentience|sentient]] [[species]] was distinguished by their [[Color|light]] skin and dark, sunken [[eye]]s.<ref name="Mando 3" />

==Species in the galaxy==
By [[9 ABY]],<ref name="Date">{{MandoDate|3}}</ref> a member of this species could be found among the [[bounty hunter]]s on the [[planet]] [[Nevarro]], taking part in the initial [[Incident on Nevarro|ambush]] of the [[Mandalorian]] [[Din Djarin]] during the [[hunt for Grogu]] but perishing during the firefight.<ref name="Mando 3" />

==Behind the scenes==
The species made their debut in the [[Chapter 3: The Sin|third episode]] of the [[2019]] television series ''[[Star Wars: The Mandalorian]]'', directed by [[Deborah Chow]].<ref name="Mando 3" />
